metadata.name: Norman Shores
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A look-alike of the lake houses on Lake Norman, North Carolina, on a summer evening. Six big houses step down the wooded slopes of both shores: walkout basements at the water, main floors with screened porches and decks, bedrooms and balconies above, garages on the shore roads, and big windows whose glass shoots out. Every house has a dock and a boathouse with a sundeck; jet skis, bass boats and a pontoon ride the lake. The east shore has the marina: a fuel dock, slips, a ship store and the Waterfront restaurant and bar with its rooftop deck. A long road bridge crosses the lake to the north; a wooded island with a cove sits in the south basin. Team Deathmatch pits shore against shore; flags in the two southern houses across the basin; hills on the island, the fuel dock and the bridge.
